en.headline: West Kowloon picnic market runs until 9pm through Sunday
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District says the Art Park harbour lawn market is open 2pm to 9pm on the Golden Week weekend.
body: The West Kowloon picnic market is open on the Art Park harbourside lawn through Sunday, one of four weekend stretches the West Kowloon Cultural District has scheduled between 18 September and 11 October.

The district's programme page lists the Golden Week dates as 1 to 4 October, with the market open from 2pm to 9pm. Thursday 1 October was an exception, when the market closed at 6pm because of National Day arrangements. The next listed weekend is 9 to 11 October, again from 2pm to 9pm.

The organiser describes the event as a gourmet market with workshops and live music on the Harbourside East Lawn. Saturday's listed workshops include a ceramic flower-print session from 2pm to 3pm. The page does not state an admission charge for the lawn itself.
Visitors can reach Art Park from Kowloon Station or Austin Station. The district has separately posted visitor notices for museum hours and crowd measures during the holiday.

zh.headline: 西九野餐市集黃金周周末開至晚上9時
zh.dek: 西九文化區表示，藝術公園海濱草坪市集10月1日至4日舉行，周六及周日由下午2時至晚上9時。
body: 西九文化區的野餐市集本周末仍在藝術公園海濱東草坪舉行。節目頁列出的檔期由9月18日至10月11日，涵蓋多個周末及公眾假期。
黃金周一段列為10月1日至4日，市集一般由下午2時至晚上9時。10月1日國慶當日因慶祝活動，市集提早至下午6時結束。下一檔列明為10月9日至11日，同樣由下午2時至晚上9時。
主辦方形容活動包括美食市集、工作坊及現場音樂。周六列出的工作坊包括下午2時至3時的花草拓印陶瓷。節目頁沒有寫明草坪入場是否收費。
藝術公園可經九龍站或柯士甸站步行前往。西九另就黃金周期間博物館開放時間及人流安排發出提示。
